properties.label: Target Form
properties.description:
Select the Joget form that holds the Microsoft Calendar Event ID to be cancelled.

Important:
• The selected form must be the same form used to create or sync the Microsoft event.
• The form must already contain a valid Microsoft Event ID.

Behavior:
• This plugin will call Microsoft Graph to cancel the event.
• Cancellation does not delete the event; it sends a cancellation notice to all attendees.

properties.label: Cancellation Mapping
properties.description:
Form field used to store the cancellation message sent to Microsoft Calendar attendees.

Usage:
• The text entered here will appear in the cancellation email/notification.
• This message is optional but strongly recommended for clarity.

Input Guidelines:
• Plain text only.
• No HTML formatting is required.
• Keep the message concise and professional.

Examples:
• "Meeting cancelled due to scheduling conflict."
• "This event is no longer required."
